ref_text: THE COLORIST SAYS FIRST OF ALL AS MY DELICIOUS PAROQUET WAS RUBY SO THIS NASTY VIPER SHALL BE BLACK AND THEN IS THE QUESTION CAN I ROUND HIM OFF EVEN THOUGH HE IS BLACK AND MAKE HIM SLIMY AND YET SPRINGY AND CLOSE DOWN CLOTTED LIKE A POOL OF BLACK BLOOD ON THE EARTH ALL THE SAME
text: The colorist says, first of all, as my delicious parakeye was ruby, so this nasty Viper shall be black. And then, as the question, can I round him off, even though he is black and make him slimy? And yet springy and close down, clotted like a pool of black blood on the earth, all the same?
